content_units: Best Laptops for a CS Student in Madrid

Context fit: ranked for your priorities in this order —   battery life  ,   keyboard comfort  ,   portability under 1.6 kg  , then enough performance for   Python, VS Code, Docker, and light Photoshop  .
All four meet the RAM/storage baseline, but the   ASUS Vivobook 15   misses your portability target at   1.70 kg  .
Ranked Comparison Table
Rank   Laptop   Price   Weight   Why it ranks here

1     Lenovo IdeaPad 5, Ryzen 7 5700U       829 EUR       1.38 kg     Best overall balance of battery efficiency, strong keyboard reputation, low weight, and the strongest multi-core performance here for Docker/dev work
2     HP Pavilion 14, Ryzen 5 5625U       749 EUR       1.41 kg     Best-value choice; very good efficiency, solid everyday keyboard, portable, and comfortably enough power for your workload
3     Acer Swift 3, i7-1165G7       899 EUR       1.20 kg     Most portable option and good battery life, but typically a less comfortable keyboard than Lenovo and weaker multicore value at the price
4     ASUS Vivobook 15, i5-1235U       799 EUR       1.70 kg     Decent performance and screen size, but too heavy for your stated limit and less ideal for daily campus carry
Ranked Options
Option 1:   Lenovo IdeaPad 5     Best overall match for your priorities     Top balance of battery, keyboard, portability, and performance

-   Pros:   Ryzen 7 5700U is excellent for Python, many browser tabs, VS Code, light Docker use, and light Photoshop; 16GB/512GB is the right baseline; 1.38 kg is easy to carry; IdeaPad keyboards are usually among the better ones in this class.
-   Cons:   Not the lightest option; battery depends on screen configuration, so it may not always beat the Swift 3 in real-world unplugged use.
-   Why it wins:   It is the safest all-rounder for a CS student who types a lot and wants fewer compromises.
Option 2:   HP Pavilion 14     Smartest budget-friendly pick     Best value under the budget cap

-   Pros:   Lowest price among the sub-1.6 kg models; Ryzen 5 5625U is still very capable for coding, containers, coursework, and Adobe basics; good portability at 1.41 kg; likely solid battery efficiency.
-   Cons:   Keyboard is usually good but not as consistently praised as Lenovo’s; less performance headroom than the Ryzen 7 if you run heavier multitasking or more Docker containers later.
-   Why it ranks second:   It gives up a bit of performance and premium feel, but saves   80 EUR   versus the Lenovo and still fits your needs well.
Option 3:   Acer Swift 3     Best for maximum portability     Lightest option at 1.20 kg
-   Pros:   Extremely portable; good fit for daily commuting and campus use; decent battery life; still enough for Python, VS Code, and light Photoshop.
-   Cons:   At   899 EUR  , it is the most expensive; i7-1165G7 is less attractive for sustained multicore work than the Ryzen 7 5700U; keyboard comfort is usually fine, but not a standout advantage.
-   Why it ranks third:   Great if weight is your top concern, but your top priority is battery life first and keyboard comfort second, where Lenovo is a better fit.
Option 4:   ASUS Vivobook 15     Only worth it if you want a bigger screen     Fails your portability rule
-   Pros:   Good mainstream performance; larger 15.6-inch display can be nicer for split-screen coding and Photoshop; fair price.
-   Cons:     1.70 kg   exceeds your preferred portability limit; larger chassis is less convenient for carrying around Madrid daily; battery may be less favorable than the best 14-inch options.
-   Why it ranks last:   It breaks one of your explicit constraints, so it cannot be recommended above lighter alternatives.
Best-Value Pick
HP Pavilion 14   is the   best-value pick  .
You save   80 EUR   versus the Lenovo while still getting:
- 16GB RAM and 512GB SSD
- good portability at   1.41 kg
- enough CPU power for   Python, VS Code, Docker, and light Photoshop
- likely strong battery efficiency from the Ryzen 5 5625U
If you want the   best laptop overall  , choose the   Lenovo IdeaPad 5  .
If you want the   best deal  , choose the   HP Pavilion 14  .
